Name: uWSGI Directory Traversal
Description: uWSGI is a Web application server that implements protocols such as WSGI, uwsgi and http, and supports running various languages through plugins. The PHP plugin in uWSGI versions prior to 2.0.17 does not correctly handle DOCUMENT_ROOT detection, allowing users to use ..%2f to traverse directories and read or run files outside the DOCUMENT_ROOT directory.
